summary: Restore the initial ʕ of the corpus reading ʕašči.
rationale: The supplied corpus verse 1/20 reads “Kətwo sidayna ʕašči, d mahzamle”. The glossary quotation lacks the initial consonant ʕ in ʕašči. This is a consonant difference, not stress, vowel length, or clitic segmentation.

summary: All three occurrences are already represented, one in each of Preterit Intransitive, Infectum and Infectum-wa. No added example, sense, idiom or correction is warranted.
I.1 lecken denotes roof leakage. The roof or roof locations are the sole overt subject, and the liquid is implicit. German lecken here means leak, with no licking sense supported.

Infectum-wa describes recurring leaks; negated Preterit Intransitive summarizes no further leakage after roof repair; negated Infectum appears in the winter-sealing purpose clause. These aspectual contexts do not justify new senses.
